 Chrisean Rock and Blueface have been all the talk in the streaming world. The on-and-off couple is back in each other’s lives and taking fans along for the ride! Most recently, the parents attended church with their son, Chrisean Jr. Posts the rapper shared during the service have fans crackin’ up. However, another clip featuring Rock and Blue sparked debate over whether their rekindled era is for love or for likes! Keep reading to catch up, chile!
 RELATED:  Chrisean Rock & Blueface Share NEW “The Porters” Video Clip & Social Media Users Are Dropping STRONG Reactions (WATCH) 
 Blueface Teases Friends For Falling Asleep In Church 
 As mentioned, clips shared by Blueface on Sunday (Oct. 18) show him sitting next to Chrisean Rock in church. Meanwhile, Jr. was sitting in his stroller in front of his parents. Blue played with Chrisean Jr., showing the 3-year-old clapping his hands. Other clips from the service showed people who Blueface seemed to know dozing off in church while he teased them awake.
 Following the service, it appears “The Porters,” as they’ve been calling themselves, stepped out to eat. Blueface filmed himself feeding Jr. a blackberry, while Chrisean enjoyed a salad in the background.

 Blueface Sparks Reactions After Calling Rock’s Income His 
 In a video shared by OnSite! on Monday (Oct. 19), Blueface appears to be on stream speaking about his income. The clip begins in the middle of him talking, just as he’s breaking down his five income types, including from rapping, his Los Angeles restaurant, Kick streaming and boxing matches. However, the first income he appeared to list was “Rock Rock’s income.”  He then warned anyone discussing his pockets to never compare him to someone only making money on Kick.
 Social Media Reacts To Rapper’s Income Comment 
 In OnSite!’s comment section , internet users didn’t hold back on reacting to the video of Blueface calling Chrisean Rock’s money, his money. To clarify, to the public’s knowledge, Rock and Blue have not yet gotten married, despite “The Porters” nickname. He proposed to her earlier this month at a nightclub, just weeks after they began spending time together while his former boo, Nevaeh Akira was still pregnant. As for the reactions to this new income discussion…well, take a look for yourself below!
 IG user @asiafanielleeee wrote, “& her fans gone say he love her 😂😂😂😂 this ain’t love! He’s using her for her money like he just said.” 
 “Well hold up 😭😭 wtf he mean he got roc income,” @daefields added.
 “😂😂imma keep saying this under these comments … she a bag to him .. all that $$ going to them kids 😂😂😂 except for hers,” @_marshiee__ commented.
 “Who cares we wouldn’t know Rock if it wasn’t for Blueface she in a 360 deal 😂,” @quinzell_3000 said.
 “Oh, so he bought her ring with her money??? Got it!! 😂,” @sweetface_kickin added.
 “If ‘what’s yours is mine’ was a person😂😂,” @bonton21 added.
 “Toothless needs to make sure she doesn’t end up roofless by the time he’s finished with her 😢,” @sarah_marie_xx_ commented.
 “Too many birds on the ground & not enough in the sky😢😂,” @meangyalll said.
 “😂😂 that man said he got rock rock income and just laughing goofy self,” @cordaew1 added.
 @sheready89_ commented, “I can’t wait for the day he flip on her like he always do 👏👏👏👏”
